### Original Description
justhtml through 1.9.1 (fixed in 1.10.0) is vulnerable to uncontrolled recursion leading to denial of service. During JustHTML() construction, TreeBuilder.finish() unconditionally calls _populate_selectedcontent(), which recursively traverses the DOM tree via _find_elements()/_find_element() without a depth bound. An attacker who can supply HTML for parsing can provide deeply nested elements (e.g., ~1000 nested <div> tags, roughly 11 KB) to exceed CPython's default recursion limit and trigger an unhandled RecursionError, which may abort parsing, fail requests, or terminate a worker/process depending on the host application's exception handling.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-892m-gcq8-2468", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-08-25T16:40:27Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-892m-gcq8-2468", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-892m-gcq8-2468"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-08-23T14:16:55Z", "published_at": "2026-08-23T15:33:06Z", "references": ["https://github.com/EmilStenstrom/justhtml/security/advisories/GHSA-v7cf-c9rm-wm3j", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-9769", "https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/justhtml-before-denial-of-service-via-deeply-nested-html", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-892m-gcq8-2468"], "repository_advisory_url": null, "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "", "summary": "Duplicate Advisory: Uncontrolled recursion DoS in JustHTML() via deeply nested HTML", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-08-25T16:40:28Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-892m-gcq8-2468", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": null, "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "justhtml"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 1.9.1"}], "withdrawn_at": "2026-08-25T16:40:27Z"}
